name: f2x50
description: f2x50 is a repository-scale benchmark for evaluating migration of Fortran software to target languages and platforms. Version 1.0.0 pins 50 public Fortran repositories at exact Git revisions, stratifies them into three structural-complexity tiers, and provides 561 versioned, target-independent behavioural contracts. Of these, 446 checks compile exact files from the pinned upstream revisions and cover 131 repository–routine pairs. The release includes machine-readable repository, probe, and source-information manifests; executable Fortran oracles and a Python reference adapter; validation and figure-generation tooling; and reproducibility documentation. The upstream repositories are identified but are not redistributed.
